title.narrative: Sustainable Economic Corridors and Urban Resilience Project - Full Mutual Reliance Framework

description.narrative: The proposed project will (i) construct a 720-meter-long bridge across the Fanga'uta Lagoon and 2.1 kilometers of approach roads, while also strengthening the government's capacity in road network management; and (ii) upgrade and construct drainage and water supply infrastructure in Nuku'alofa, the capital of the Kingdom of Tonga, to address projected increases in rainfall intensity and flood frequency due to climate change. The project aims to integrate planned infrastructure developments in Tonga, including the flagship Fanga'uta Lagoon Bridge, into a broader, climate-resilient investment strategy for urban and peri-urban areas. In addition to strengthening key economic corridors essential for Tonga's long-term connectivity and development, the project is designed to safeguard livelihoods, enhance accessibility, and promote sustainable growth amid increasing climate and natural hazard risks.
